name: mob-mcp-crm
tagline: Personal CRM via MCP — chat naturally with your contact list
description: mob-mcp-crm is a personal CRM exposed through the Model Context Protocol, letting you chat naturally with an AI about your contacts, birthdays, and follow-ups. It runs self-hosted as a Node.js app backed by SQLite, so your relationship data stays on your machine. For anyone who wants a lightweight, AI-friendly way to keep track of personal relationships without a heavy SaaS CRM, it is a clever, minimal approach.
highlights: Personal CRM exposed through the Model Context Protocol
Chat naturally with an AI about contacts, birthdays, and follow-ups
Self-hosted Node.js app backed by SQLite
Keeps your relationship data local and private
curatorNote: A personal CRM you talk to through MCP is a genuinely fresh take on relationship management. Self-hosted and SQLite-backed, it keeps private data where it belongs.
